  "tokenized_directions": [
    {
      "step": 1,
      "text": "COOK the {{ing_01|fish}} IN {{ing_02|BROTH}} AND {{ing_03|OIL}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 2,
      "text": "RETIRE WHEN HALF DONE."
    },
    {
      "step": 3,
      "text": "SOAK {{ing_04|BOILED TURNIPS}}, CHOP VERY FINE AND SQUEEZE THEM IN YOUR HANDS SO THAT THEY HAVE NO MORE MOISTURE IN THEM."
    },
    {
      "step": 4,
      "text": "THEN COMBINE THEM WITH the {{ing_01|fish}} AND LET THEM SIMMER WITH PLENTY OF {{ing_03|OIL}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 5,
      "text": "AND WHILE THIS COOKS, CRUSH {{ing_05|CUMIN}}, {{ing_06|HALF OF THAT AMOUNT OF LAUREL BERRIES}}, AND, BECAUSE OF THE COLOR, ADD {{ing_07|SAFFRON}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 6,
      "text": "BIND WITH {{ing_08|RICE FLOUR}} TO GIVE IT THE RIGHT CONSISTENCY."
    },
    {
      "step": 7,
      "text": "ADD {{ing_09|A DASH OF VINEGAR}} AND SERVE."
    }
